text:
elaine: quick sync — propose MVP retention: 90d hot + 1y cold exportable for Dedicated/Private. Hosted: metered cold exports only.

sanjay: +1. Most customers ask for 90/365/3y; 7y is rare.

maria: runtime retention toggles that change GC must be Dedicated/Private only. Hosted gets scheduled/billed exports.

kevin: implementation note: tenant-prefixed objects + lifecycle rules. Exports produce a manifest with object list, sha256 hashes, timestamps, and signer metadata.

ariane: legal: SOC2 needs signed manifest + upload timestamp + key-rotation log to prove chain-of-custody. If BYOK requested, manifest must be verifiable by the customer key.

ops-oncall: ops risk — long retention increases storage, index sizes, backups. Require per-tenant quotas and alerts at 75/90/100%. Exports should be rate-limited/off-peak.

anya (UX): Console must show retention profile selector, scheduled exports, manifest download + verification instructions, and per-tenant cost estimate. Show who signed the manifest.

elaine: acceptance criteria for MVP: 1) tenant queries (<=30d) meet SLA (95% <2s); 2) exportable signed manifest downloadable; 3) Console surfaces retention state and cost; 4) legal signoff on manifest format.

action items: sanjay: cost model for 90/365/3y by 2024-04-05; kevin: manifest/signing spike by 2024-03-29; infra/ops: quota & alerts by 2024-04-05; ariane: chain-of-custody signoff by 2024-03-27; anya: mocks by 2024-03-31.

elaine: ship Q2 beta for Dedicated/Private (MVP). Hosted extended retention pilot in Q3. thumbs? :thumbsup:
